p=Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')

  {"step":2,"file":"src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"fuzz_parse_http_request","line":1632,"var":"helper.buffer","code":".buffer = &(struct lwan_value){.value = data_copy, .len = length},","note":"The parser helper points request parsing at the attacker-controlled buffer."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_http_request","line":1160,"var":"buffer","code":"char *buffer = helper->buffer->value;","note":"Parsing begins from the copied request bytes."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_http_request","line":1170,"var":"buffer","code":"buffer = identify_http_path(request, path);","note":"The request line is split into method and path before header parsing."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_http_request","line":1174,"var":"parse_headers(...)","code":"if (UNLIKELY(!parse_headers(helper, buffer, helper->buffer->value + helper->buffer->len)))","note":"Header parsing is invoked on the attacker-controlled remainder of the request."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_headers","line":526,"var":"next_hdr","code":"char *next_hdr = memchr(next_chr, '\\r', (size_t)(buffer_end - p));","note":"The parser scans for CR-delimited header boundaries within the supplied buffer."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_headers","line":533,"var":"header_start[n_headers++]","code":"header_start[n_headers++] = next_chr; header_start[n_headers++] = next_hdr;","note":"Each header start/end pair is recorded for later field extraction."},
  {"step":8,"file":"src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_headers","line":548,"var":"helper->authorization","code":"helper->authorization = HEADER(\"Authorization\");","note":"An Authorization header is recognized and stored as a slice into the same buffer."},
  {"step":9,"file":"src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"HEADER","line":514,"var":"value","code":"char *value = p + sizeof(\": \") - 1;","note":"The header value pointer is derived directly from the attacker-controlled header text."},
  {"step":10,"file":"src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"prepare_for_response","line":1208,"var":"helper->authorization","code":"if (!lwan_http_authorize(request, &helper->authorization, url_map->authorization.realm, url_map->authorization.password_file))","note":"The stored Authorization slice is passed to the authentication routine."},
  {"step":11,"file":"src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-http-authorize.c","function":"lwan_http_authorize","line":157,"var":"authorization->value","code":"authorization->value += basic_len; authorization->len -= basic_len;","note":"The Basic prefix is stripped, leaving the attacker-controlled base64 payload."},
  {"step":12,"file":"src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-http-authorize.c","function":"authorize","line":137,"var":"decoded","code":"decoded = base64_decode((unsigned char *)authorization->value, authorization->len, &decoded_len);","note":"The base64 payload is decoded into a new attacker-influenced buffer."},
  {"step":13,"file":"src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-http-authorize.c","function":"authorize","line":142,"var":"colon","code":"colon = memchr(decoded, ':', decoded_len);","note":"The decoded credentials are searched for the username/password separator."},
  {"step":14,"file":"src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-http-authorize.c","function":"authorize","line":147,"var":"decoded","code":"looked_password = hash_find(rpf->entries, decoded);","note":"The decoded username is used as the lookup key into the password hash."},
  {"step":15,"file":"src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-http-authorize.c","function":"authorize","line":147,"var":"decoded","code":"looked_password = hash_find(rpf->entries, decoded);","note":"The vulnerability is a global-buffer-overflow READ in the hash lookup path when the decoded username is not properly bounded during key comparison."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(p)
PY
